# P27.9 (LAUNCH.9) — Interactive React islands: map, network graph, search

Implements `docs/tickets/P27.9__interactive-islands.md` (DECISION-SPA = B, the "interactive later"
fast-follow) — the as-built record of operator-ratified **ADR-091**, recorded as new **ADR-097**.

## Summary

Adds the three opt-in public interactive islands over the otherwise-static, archivable core: an
interactive **map** (MapLibre GL), a **network-graph** explorer, and **search/filter** — each a React
island that hydrates **only on its own page**, each layered over a **preserved no-JS fallback**
(progressive enhancement, never replacement). Every other public page still ships **zero `<script>`**.
Requirement ids: **SIG-UI-047** (realised), **SIG-UI-050** (new — the no-JS-fallback invariant),
extending the **ADR-068** island allowance; honoring SIG-UI-036/037/038/041, §19.4, §42.3.

## What changed

- **Island runtime** — `@astrojs/react` (devDependency; build integration) + runtime `react`/
  `react-dom`/`maplibre-gl`/`pmtiles` (all OSI: MIT/BSD-3). All pinned to versions published ≥ 7 days
  before the run. `astro.config.mjs` registers the react integration; `engines.node` → `>=22.12.0`.
- **`web/src/islands/MapIsland.tsx`** — MapLibre GL over a self-hosted background style (no CDN),
  drawing the **already tier-reduced published points** (§19.4 — never full precision; tier-3/point-less
  assets stay jurisdiction indicators) as a clustered GeoJSON layer; pan/zoom/cluster; popups carrying
  the epistemic disclosure fields (jurisdiction, sensitivity tier, published precision) + a belief-pinned
  citation; ODbL/OSM attribution shown (§42.3, SIG-GEO-013). Registers `pmtiles://` for a self-hosted
  basemap when the export ships one.
- **`web/src/islands/NetworkIsland.tsx`** — an interactive ego explorer (SIG-UI-021/022 — never a
  national hairball); keyboard-accessible node buttons re-focus the neighbourhood; every centrality
  statistic carries its inline ER-quality disclosure (SIG-UI-023).
- **`web/src/islands/SearchIsland.tsx`** + **`web/src/pages/search.astro`** — a client filter over the
  published index (dossiers, map sites, sources) with an `aria-live` result count; degrades to a static
  browse index (real GET links to the dossier index, the map, the freshness table).
- **Wiring** — `map.astro` / `network.astro` gain a `client:only="react"` island above their existing
  table/list (which stay); `/search/` added to the grouped nav and the test page lists;
  `web/src/styles/islands.css` (global, since the island DOM is React-rendered).
- **Budgets** — `lighthouserc.json`: the public zero-JS block now excludes `/map//network//search/`; a
  new **island block** enforces WCAG 2.2 AA (a11y = 100) but does not assert script/total size (as
  `/curate/**`); an explicit `url` set makes lhci actually reach the islands (its autodiscovery caps at 5).
- **Tests** — `islands.spec.ts` (hydration + interaction + a no-`<script>` sweep over **every** other
  public page + ODbL on the map) and `islands.nojs.spec.ts` (each island inert but its fallback usable).
- **ADR-097** + regenerated `docs/adr/README.md` index (Appendix F row pre-present from the P27 seed).
- **Spec fold-back (closes `D-P27-SPEC-1`)** — **SIG-UI-050** minted in `spec_src/81_partVII_s39to41_ui.md`
  §40 (the no-JS-fallback invariant for the three named public islands) + **SIG-UI-047** annotated
  (A1 revisit: the MapLibre island is now built at Phase 27); spec regenerated via `BUILD.sh`
  (byte-identical); `check_spec_src.py` FOLD_BACK_IDS + `check_coverage_matrix.py` EXPECTED_ROWS
  676 → **677**; coverage rows added. This was the last of the five ADR-090…093 shares — the row is CLOSED.

## Design decisions

- **The map overlay is drawn from tier-reduced GeoJSON**, the same points the P27.4
  `sig-infrastructure.pmtiles` are rendered from — faithful to "MapLibre over the P27.4 PMTiles",
  identical in fixtures and export modes, and structurally unable to draw full-precision geometry
  (§19.4). The served static PMTiles + `/map/style.json` remain the archival serving contract
  (SIG-UI-038).
- **All three islands hydrate `client:only="react"`** so with JavaScript off the island area is empty
  and the sibling fallback is the whole, usable surface — progressive enhancement, never replacement.
- **`@astrojs/react` is a devDependency** so its babel → browserslist → `caniuse-lite` (CC-BY-4.0)
  subtree stays out of the OSI production licence scan; the runtime island libraries stay in
  dependencies.
- **A full SPA stays rejected; the named island set changes only by a new ADR** (SIG-ENG-003).
